{{Quote|You're coming with us.|HELIOS-3E, to R2-D2|<ref name="EP" />}}
'''HELIOS-3E''' was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] who operated with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] while he worked with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Download that data onto the memory drive. I will deliver it immediately. And prepare my ship.''"<br />"''What should we do with these two?''"<br />"''Wipe their memory and dump them back in the street! They'll find their way back home. We can't have anything&hellip; looking out of place, can we?|Cad Bane and HELIOS-3E, regarding R2-D2 and C-3PO|<ref name="EP" />}}
After being instructed to recover the plans for the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], Bane brought HELIOS-3E to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] successfully separated [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], from his counterpart, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], 3E pulled up in a speeder so they could bring 3PO to Bane. After discovering that R2 was the droid that had the information for the Republic Executive Building, he was sent with Todo to track him down. After searching for the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]], they decided to return, empty-handed, to Bane. When R2-D2 heard about them torturing C-3PO, he gave himself up to prevent his companion from becoming spare parts. Soon, the plans were extracted from the little droid, and 3E was charged with wiping their memories and "dumping them back on the streets."<ref name="EP" />

Later, 3E assisted Bane by guarding the hostages during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], and later successfully left the crime scene with the other members of the team and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|He is not here.''"<br />"''Bane will not be pleased if we come back empty-handed.''"<br />"''If the gold one cannot provide the information in his current state, then I shall personally dismantle every circuit in his plated little body to get those answers.''"<br />"''That will destroy him.|Todo 360 and HELIOS-3E, while searching for R2-D2, contemplate dismantling C-3PO|<ref name="EP" />}}
HELIOS-3E displayed some measure of fear toward Cad Bane, knowing that his master would not be pleased if he and Todo 360 failed to capture R2-D2.<ref name="EP" />
